scenarios.observed: Read-only comparison leaves work unchanged. Compatible row IDs/cells, prior answers/templates and original files survive adoption and restart.

scenarios.test: source schedules retain alphanumeric sample identifiers and narrative asset results with signed numeric differences

scenarios.test: selected materiality overrides bind source rows and reopen sampling and evaluation without losing signed history

scenarios.observed: Candidate amounts remain separate from selected overall, performance, specific and zero trivial thresholds. Operative source rows use the owning decisions. Self-review, missing rationale, downgrade and stale sample use are denied; review history and the original selection survive restart.

scenarios.test: approved report preparation connects exact issue to independently completed assembly and custody
scenarios.action: approved qualified report preparation through actual issue, delivery outcomes, assembly diagnostics and independent custody
scenarios.observed: Wrong report template, unauthorized approval, stale preparation and unsigned issue are denied. Ambiguous delivery is reconciled before retry. Original-file corruption blocks assembly; return and independent approval bind the exact index. Corrupt custody is returned with an owner, restored and reoffered. Expired/revoked retrieval is denied; successor retention/holds, original bytes and restart history remain intact.

scenarios.test: approved materiality and its revision govern the same sample and misstatement evaluation
scenarios.action: benchmark assessment through approved scoped thresholds, sampling, and reevaluation
scenarios.observed: Explicit benchmark, users, comparative, stability and scoped rationale were reviewed against retained evidence. Scoped performance materiality fed sampling. A reduction reopened the dependent work and changed the outstanding comparison while retaining the earlier selection and evaluation.

scenarios.test: provisional intake, subsequent-period confirmation and signed terms survive independent review
scenarios.action: intake conversion and exact signed terms
scenarios.observed: Both intake origins and distinct periods retain exact signed terms. A signed scope amendment pauses substantive work and authorization until the partner independently reapproves its exact version and reassesses the acceptance scope.

scenarios.test: approved roster capacity and reassignment preserve historical staff sign-offs
scenarios.observed: Overbooking, expired credential, eligibility check, reassignment, retained named signature, and restart.

scenarios.observed: The migrated engagement kept its stable ID, exact archived bytes, accepted evidence and revisions after restart.

scenarios.test: the extended engagement preserves its original 34-register journey and scoped recoverable archive
